title: paged-kv-cache-block-allocator-adaptive-pinning-heuristic-and-locality-optimizations
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: reduce KV cache fragmentation and unnecessary evictions under mixed latency/throughput workloads. Current paged KV cache allocator favors first-fit allocation which increases cold misses and cross-GPU migrations for hot keys. This PR introduces an adaptive pinning heuristic plus locality-aware allocation scoring to improve reuse of recently-used blocks and reduce eviction churn.

What I changed: implemented a BlockAllocator interface refactor to support multiple allocation strategies; added AdaptivePinningHeuristic that tracks per-key access heat and pins frequently accessed key blocks to a local pool for a TTL; added locality-aware scoring so allocations prefer blocks within the same locality group (GPU/NUMA) when available; added a small LRU backing eviction policy for pinned pool under memory pressure; exposed runtime knobs via config: kv.cache.adaptive_pinning.enabled, kv.cache.pinning.ttl_ms, kv.cache.localization.weight.

Benchmark summary: measured on 8xA100 serving mix (chat+completion) synthetic workload: 7-12% throughput improvement at p95 SLO when adaptive pinning enabled; eviction rate down ~15% on long-tail conversational sessions; median latency unchanged, p99 latency improved ~8ms in high-concurrency scenarios. Benchmarks and harness details in CI perf job.

Compatibility & rollout: feature off by default. We ship a config flag and a staged rollout: canary (10% traffic) -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error or regression. No API changes.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests for allocator and heuristics
- [x] Integration perf benchmarks added to CI
- [x] Docs/ops guide for config flags and tuning
- [x] Backwards compatible: existing cache state is preserved when feature disabled

Notes: See Linear ENG-8421 and ENG-8583 for design notes and perf goals. Related PRs: pr-78001, pr-80021 (previous allocator/pinning work).

release_notes:
- Introduces adaptive pinning heuristic for paged KV cache (opt-in via kv.cache.adaptive_pinning.enabled)
- Adds locality-aware allocation scoring to reduce cross-locality allocations and evictions
- Improves tail-latency and throughput in mixed chat/completion workloads
- New runtime metrics: kv.cache.metrics.pinning_hit_ratio, kv.cache.metrics.localization_score
notes_for_oncall: Feature disabled by default. If enabling in production, watch kv.cache.metrics.pinning_hit_ratio and eviction_rate. Rollback via config toggle. If memory pressure alerts fire (kv_cache_evictions > threshold) disable immediately.
